description: Append-only Microverse skill tree preserving the 18 production root skills and adding three fixed specializations plus one mastery beneath every root.

derived_skill_development_vdf.root_development: No VDF is added to the 18 Civilization-issued root skills. Within each civilization type, the immutable source_life_signal_identifier selects exactly one of six fixed root-skill bands.

gated_capability.route_key_policy: Stable lower-kebab keys are generator inputs. Every emitted fixed wrapper must constrain Ship.active_skill_type to required_skill_code and clear it in the replacement Ship.

compatibility.reason: TechnologySkill meaning is its exact numeric skill_type; changing a gate would strand issued reusable skill objects and alter Type I/II/III progression.

execution.skill_consumption: Reusable skill proof rotates its key; evidence resources and components are consumed by the fixed development action.
execution.recipe_amount_semantics: Component and artifact amount 1 consumes one complete amount-1 output object. Resource evidence uses an exact whole-stack amount emitted by an existing extraction or refinement action. Partial stack consumption is never implicit.

excluded_from_minimum: ship-tier variants of one extraction route

new_body_routes.assignment: Assign each fixed extraction or refinement route to the narrowest semantically correct root or derived skill; rarity alone never selects the skill.
tier_policy: Type I covers conventional materials, chemistry, genetics, electronics, and physical infrastructure.
Type II covers advanced matter, stellar energy, computation, precision fabrication, navigation, and engineered biospheres.
Type III covers exotic matter, spacetime, galactic information systems, stellar manipulation, planetary biosphere genesis, and civilization-scale systems.
new_body_routes.no_balance_padding: Do not assign a route to an unrelated skill merely to increase its count; use component recipes and derived capabilities for balance.

component_routes.data_catalysts: Terminal data resources remain meaningful recipe catalysts/evidence rather than dead-end commodities.
component_routes.derived_skill_role: Specializations and masteries gate advanced component variants, analysis, anchors, charts, links, infrastructure, and other named outputs; they do not replace their parent root's existing gates.
component_routes.derived_route_guard: The 72 derived capability routes are additive. Do not move a production root gate or one of the 41 root-balance component gates to a derived skill.

warp_roles.legacy_policy: Preserve the production v1 ExtractAnomalyWarpCoordinate and ExtractAnomalyTimeCoordinate gates on Spacetime Engineering code 14.
warp_roles.deterministic_reveal: Destination reveal remains a fixed stable-identifier band comparison; the skill gates acquisition or construction, not deterministic reveal rerolling.
